Message:
[ALSA] hda-codec - Clevo M540JE, M550JE laptops (Nvidia MCP51 chipset, ALC883 codec)

We need to enable External Amplifier on this laptops. This patch basicly
adds laptop-eapd model to ALC883 codec.
